metadata.title: The Probate Mistake New Real Estate Investors Make (Florida Attorney Case Study)
metadata.author: Courtney Fricke
metadata.shortDescription:
A newer Real Estate investor found what looked like a great probate opportunity.

There was just one problem. Actually, there were four.

Four separate probates needed to be opened to get the ownership cleaned up.

The investor hired Florida probate attorney Al Nicoletti, moved forward with the probate process, and then discovered something during the rest of their due diligence that killed the entire deal.

In this micro episode of the Messy Money Podcast, Al breaks down what went wrong and the expensive lesson every investor working probate and curative title deals should understand.

What You'll Learn:

-Why solving the probate problem isn't enough
-The due diligence mistake this investor made before opening probate
-Why probate and curative investors can get tunnel vision
-What investors should investigate before spending money curing an ownership problem
-How to avoid solving an expensive title problem on a deal you never should have pursued
